info.title: FPR API
info.description: Generated from the route contracts in `@fpr/contracts` by `pnpm contracts:openapi`. `x-roles` lists the roles a route accepts. `x-anonymize` marks a field the anonymizer replaces for an anonymous viewer: `personal`, `euro`, or `quantity`.

get.summary: The standings by balance, or by gain over a period
The shares held in the race, ranked by their change
Every member with their curve, gain, balance and top holdings
Every member's gain at each close, then provisional points
